Name: RIDEABLE Kitsutsune's Chocobos for Adopt 'n Skin
Author: elebuu
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/s5D8ZlI.png[/img]﻿

Pretty much just what it says on the box! I converted [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/ride-able-chocobo-ff14-style-lavender-coral-pink-ect-added.112156/]Kitsutsune's original chocobo horse sprites[/url]﻿ from xnb to png, then renamed the pngs to meet Adopt 'n Skin conventions. Just pop the img files into your Adopt 'n Skin skins folder. Happy horsemanship! 

I have only tested this with my own save file, I will say. ^^; This is technically the first mod I've ever 'made', so I'm not sure what to expect! I also use BFAV and SVE if that makes a difference.

Credit where credit is due, of course--to Kitsutsune, for the beautiful sprite work! Kweh kweh!

Compatibility note: This DOES seem to work fine with BFAV Chocobos installed simultaneously!
